question: Will Stellar (XLM) reach 1 USDT by the end of 2026?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the XLM/USDT spot price on Binance reaches or exceeds 1.00 USDT at any point before or at the market's settlement time.
- "No": Wins if the XLM/USDT spot price on Binance has not reached 1.00 USDT at any point before or at the market's settlement time.

Clarifications:
- "Reaches" means the XLM/USDT last traded price on Binance spot equals or exceeds 1.00 USDT at any observed moment within the market's resolution window, not only at the precise settlement timestamp.
